clips.send: A mom sends this to her partner who says tap water is fine - anxiety, a reason to finally filter it.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points out that fluoride in drinking water is banned in many countries, where it's treated as a health risk rather than a benefit.

His list of what he ties to it: thyroid problems, weight gain, low metabolism and low mood.

His reminder: your skin is the largest organ in your body, and whatever touches it in the shower gets absorbed too - not just what you drink.

Do you know whether your tap water or your shower is actually filtered?

#kevintrudeau #fluoride #waterfilter #thyroidhealth #tapwater #wbdaily

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone stuck in a funk today - a small, free thing to actually try.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau, on The Kevin Trudeau Show, says wealthy people have used the same trick for centuries when they're stuck on a problem: go outside and look at things far away.

His explanation: it shifts the brain out of a stressed state and helps the mind settle enough to find a solution, especially near water or trees.

His grandmother put it simpler. When he asked her what to do about a case of the blues, she said one thing: get outside and go for a walk.

What's the last problem a walk actually helped you think through?

#kevintrudeau #mentalhealth #walking #stressrelief #mindsetshift #wbdaily

clips.send: A dad sends this to his family's group chat before the weekly grocery run - anxiety, a reason to read labels.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau cites a study claiming more than 3,600 chemicals can leach into food during manufacturing, processing, packaging and storage - before it ever reaches a plate.

His point isn't just what's added to food. It's what the processing itself adds along the way, chemical by chemical, that ends up in the body.

His view: that's a real reason ultra-processed food is worse for you than whole food, beyond the sugar and the label.

How much of what's in your fridge is processed versus whole food?

#kevintrudeau #ultraprocessedfood #foodchemicals #foodlabels #cleaneating #wbdaily

clips.send: A parent sends this to someone whose kid has stubborn dandruff - hope, a fix that isn't another shampoo.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau, on The Kevin Trudeau Show, tells a story about a family member with stubborn dandruff and a shelf full of medicated shampoo that never fixed it.

He says he gently brought up two things instead: bathing more often and cleaning up what the person was eating.

His claim: within a few weeks of fixing the nutrition, the dandruff was gone, no new shampoo involved.

Has anyone in your house tried fixing a skin problem from the shampoo aisle instead of the plate?

#kevintrudeau #nutrition #skinhealth #dandruff #wholefood #wbdaily
